analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the last 3 trading sessions. RSI remains in the neutral zone, failing to break out of the 30-45 range, and the MACD histogram is worsening, transitioning from positive to negative. ADX at 30.5 indicates a clear trend, but -DI is above +DI, suggesting strong downward pressure. The volume ratio of 0.78 over 5 days indicates a lack of directional conviction. The current price of 61,995 KRW is near the swing support level of 61,145 KRW. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach until further indicator improvement or clear directional confirmation.
